description: Which values a record mentions, by kind, and where they are (EPOCH-581). Each rule names one field of one source and what it holds; a value's shape never decides its kind (measured 2026-10-20 on a real backup: 129 columns had a phone number's shape, most of them coordinates, byte counts and scores). The field's name is the entity's role. Shapes only check a rule: a value that doesn't fit its kind is counted as unreadable, never stored. The Python reader is entity_rules.py; scripts/check_entity_rules.py runs every rule against a real iLEAPP output.

not_covered.own_wifi_mac: The phone's own Wi-Fi addresses (WiFi Scanned Networks: MAC Used For Network, Private MAC Computed For Network) are the device itself, not another device or network.
not_covered.uniform_type_ids: Type identifiers (public.jpeg, Uniform Type ID, Attachment Type) have a bundle ID's shape but name a file type, not an app.
not_covered.random_bluetooth_addresses: A Bluetooth LE address of type Random rotates, so it identifies no device; only Public addresses are read as devices, and Random ones are counted.
not_covered.phone_numbers_in_text: A number inside free text is not read as a phone number: in text, digits with a phone number's shape are as often amounts, codes and times. URLs, email addresses and IP addresses have shapes nothing else has, and are read from text.
not_covered.cookie_values: A cookie's value is the site's own opaque identifier. Measured on a real backup (2026-10-20), its dotted numbers have an IPv4 address's shape inside longer identifiers; nothing says they are addresses.
not_covered.note_snippets: Notes "Snippet" is the start of "Note Contents", which is read.
not_covered.pending_research: Values that carry an identifier inside an Apple-internal format are reviewed under EPOCH-582 before a rule reads them: InteractionC Contacts "Content URL", Personalization Portrait "Group ID", Photos "Adjustment Format ID", Health Source Devices "Local ID".
not_covered.file_urls: A file URL (file:///…) names a path on the device, not a host, so it is not read as a URL. File paths are not a kind yet.
not_covered.apple_maps_generated_links: Apple Maps Trip and Significant Location Google Maps Link fields are generated by iLEAPP from coordinates, not URLs present in source records, so they are not treated as evidence URLs.
not_covered.search_terms_redirects: Safari Browser - Search Terms' "Redirect Source" and "Redirect Destination" hold four-digit numbers, not URLs, despite their names: 103 values across two reference backups, every one numeric (checked 2026-10-15, EPOCH-491).
